hooks.name: copy-guard
hooks.description: Block clinical-decision, travel-time, coverage, and person-scoring language in copy and templates.

hooks.name: loop-rules-tests
hooks.description: State transitions, stuck rules, distance, and ranking are the product's core; re-test on every change.

hooks.name: verify-drafting
hooks.description: Any change to drafting re-runs citation/number/copy verification, including adversarial cases.

hooks.name: fhir-validate
hooks.description: Re-validate referral FHIR bundles when export or models change.

hooks.name: sources-check
hooks.description: Public data snapshots must stay documented.

action.prompt: A public data snapshot changed. Check that data/public/SOURCES.md lists this file with its source URL, agency, retrieval date, and filters. Add or fix the entry if needed. Do not modify the data file.

hooks.name: spec-sync-on-stop
hooks.description: Keep tasks.md and docs/KIRO.md honest at the end of each agent turn.

action.prompt: Compare the work just finished with .kiro/specs/relay-referral-loop/tasks.md. Tick only tasks whose tests pass. If a hook failed and was fixed this turn, or the implementation deviated from requirements.md/design.md, add a dated one-line entry to docs/KIRO.md saying what happened and why.
